evidence:
Shared-state model: task/tests/test.sh:104-113 starts one app process on one DB_PATH. Lines 203-227 run the gates suite and then the scored suite with 'rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1', so every dimension works on the same running database, one after another. The order of dimensions inside a suite is not stated anywhere I read and was not measured, so I reviewed every dimension pair in both orders.

What earlier dimensions write:
- Render (gates/render/prompt.md:9): 'Do not create, move or send anything, and do not open any conversation.'
- Constraints (gates/constraints/prompt.md:9 and judge.toml hro_gate_shared): adds one card with a unique name and email to the seeded Data Analyst job and is told 'Do not create a new job, move, reject or message anything here'.
- Functional, polish and visual each run the same global gate, which adds one unique card to Data Analyst Applied (functional/prompt.md:11, polish/prompt.md:11, visual/prompt.md:11).
- Functional mutates only its own jobs J1, J2 and J3 and its own cards. It also adds messages and moves read markers on Tomas's new J2 conversation and Noor's Platform Engineer conversation, and it calls the single-use restart.
- Polish uses its own new job and cards (polish/prompt.md:14) and sends messages in Noor's Platform Engineer conversation (judge.toml hro_pol_live_thread, failed_send and session_resume). It may leave Rafael's reply and note drafts behind.
- Visual is read-only after its gate: 'Do not move cards or send messages' (visual/prompt.md:14).

How later readers tolerate this, in either order:
(a) app_context.md:27-31, injected into every prompt: 'Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count.'
(b) functional/prompt.md:15: 'Earlier reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages. Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol ... never move another review's records, and never rely on starting counts.'
(c) Seed-anchored functional legs, each checked against every mutator:
- Z reads Lena's unread count of 1. Seed: APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena's read_count is 2. Polish says 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation' (polish/prompt.md:24), visual sends nothing, the gates open no conversation, and Z itself says not to sign in as Lena again.
- Z reads the seeded Platform Engineer Applied and Screen order and Noor's note. No dimension moves cards on that job (Z: 'Move nothing on that job'; visual is read-only; polish works on its own job).
- K and hro_candidate_view check Noor at Interviewing and Application received, and Tomas's Data Analyst application at In review. The wording is 'includes', and nothing moves APP-101, APP-302 or APP-201. Gate cards on Data Analyst use unique emails.
- hro_restart compares against a before-restart baseline recorded in D (functional/prompt.md:59), not against the seed.
(d) Seed-derived counts are measured relative to what was observed:
- T: 'counts read relative to their values before you act' (prompt.md:47).
- Noor's paging: 'count the messages shown, then bring in earlier ones repeatedly'. The judge sees the remaining count however many messages polish added. app_context.md:30 gives 120 only as a starting fact.
- U: Rafael's count and total 'rise by exactly two' from a fresh read, and Mei's expected count is 'counted from the sequence you observed'.
- Polish's live, earlier-place and failed-send rows are relative ('sent once', 'same message stays at the same position').
(e) Leftover drafts: polish/prompt.md:14 says 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own.' The polish session_resume check for Mei's empty boxes uses polish's own card, and functional leaves no Mei drafts (Mei only sends).
(f) Visual accepts any board state: 'a Board for a job with cards in several stages (a seeded job is fine)'.
(g) The restart is single-use and owned by functional D. Later dimensions just see the restarted process, and test.sh:169 rewrites app.pid.

Within functional, the protocols are ordered so each step reads the state it needs. For example, R says 'Use a J1 card in Screen (move one there as Rafael if none is)', which covers the case where Screen on J1 is empty after L and C. T falls back to 'open a new job J3' if Tomas's address is already on J2. The replay rules read the current version first (prompt.md:17).

Colderwater lessons that bear on this row:
- Lesson 15/16 (restart baseline and no double grading): satisfied. D compares against its own recorded baseline.
- Lesson 17/18 (drift): every mutating step in all five prompts was re-read against the current bytes.

Weak app that might pass: an app that reseeds or wipes the database between dimensions or on restart. hro_restart fails it ('the starting data is not loaded again'; own records compared). Each dimension's gate also fails it if its gate card is not kept. An app that hard-codes Lena's '1' is caught by U's relative counts on a new conversation.

Latent P3 note, not a defect: the functional prompt has no counterpart of polish's 'record it and clear it' sentence for message boxes. Suppose polish runs before functional and an app keeps drafts on the server per user ('Where drafts are kept is up to you', hireops_rules.md:181, although line 176 says 'on that browser'). Then polish's leftover Rafael reply draft in a seeded conversation could already be in the box when functional T types 'a different unsent reply in another conversation'. A literal judge might read the combined text as a lost or changed draft. The golden keeps drafts client-side (threads.js:4, 113, 125), and each dimension runs its own isolated Playwright browser, so the golden is unaffected. The leftover can only arise from a server-side reading that conflicts with 'on that browser', and only if RewardKit's dimension order is not alphabetical. Mitigation (optional): add polish's 'record and clear pre-existing box text' sentence to functional/prompt.md, or tell T to use Tomas's new J2 conversation and a functional-created conversation for both drafts.

No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'), so how dimensions interact at runtime and in what order RewardKit runs them have not been observed. This verdict is a source-level review of the frozen bytes only.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening (P3): in tests/scored/functional/prompt.md protocol T, add 'If a message box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own', matching polish/prompt.md:14.
